```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-deep
#| fig-cap: "Deep tree: get and nonexistent key across the CoordSpace family"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

metrics = ['get 100\n(µs)', 'missing key\n(ns)']
cs2_vals = [0.05, 0.39]
csvm3_vals = [0.05, 0.39]
csn19_vals = [7.04, 2.30]
hm_vals = [3.53, 20.1]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))
x = np.arange(len(metrics))
w = 0.2
bars1 = ax.bar(x - 1.5*w, cs2_vals, w,
               label='CoordSpace2', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
bars2 = ax.bar(x - 0.5*w, csvm3_vals, w,
               label='CoordSpaceM3', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='xxx')
bars3 = ax.bar(x + 0.5*w, csn19_vals, w,
               label='CoordSpaceN19', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='...')
bars4 = ax.bar(x + 1.5*w, hm_vals, w,
               label='HashMap', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(metrics, fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('Latency')
ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc='upper left')

# Annotate bars
units = ['µs', 'ns']
for bars, vals in [(bars1, cs2_vals), (bars2, csvm3_vals), (bars3, csn19_vals), (bars4, hm_vals)]:
    for bar, val, unit in zip(bars, vals, units):
        fmt = f'{val:.2f} {unit}' if val >= 0.1 else f'{val:.2f} {unit}'
        offset = 1.25 if val < 1 else (1.15 if val < 10 else 1.08)
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() * offset,
                fmt, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
